q: How do I get a quote?
a: Fill in the quote form on our website or call us. We reply within one business day and book a free roof assessment.

q: Which areas do you install in?
a: We install across Queensland and northern New South Wales. We do not currently install elsewhere.

q: How long does an installation take?
a: A typical home system is installed in one to two days after approvals are in place.

q: How much roof space do I need?
a: Roughly 1.8 square metres per panel. A 6.6 kW system of 15 panels needs about 27 square metres of usable roof.
Panels carry a 25-year performance warranty, inverters 10 years, and our workmanship is covered for 5 years.

q: Do you handle the paperwork for the feed-in tariff and grid connection?
a: Yes. We lodge the grid connection application and the feed-in tariff paperwork on your behalf at no extra cost.
Yes. We offer 0 percent interest payment plans for up to 24 months through a partner lender, subject to approval.

q: Can I add a battery later?
a: Yes, if your inverter is battery-ready. We check this during the assessment and can retrofit a battery at any time.

q: Does my system work during a blackout?
a: Standard systems switch off during a blackout for safety. Only systems with a battery and backup gateway can supply power during an outage.

q: How often should I clean the panels?
a: Rain usually keeps them clean. We suggest a gentle rinse once or twice a year if you are in a dusty area.
Our support team is available 8am to 5pm AEST, Monday to Friday. Emergencies are answered by phone 24/7.

q: How can I monitor my system's production?
a: Every system includes the Acme Solar app, which shows live and historical production and savings.
